title: Inter don't need Lautaro for Como | Jones and Stones back, Gazzetta says
description:
Inter don't need Lautaro for Como — Jones and Stones are back in group work.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=65

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

REPORTED · Gazzetta dello Sport via FCInter1908 · Nov 5 — Jones and Stones return to full group work and should be in the squad for Como; Lautaro's left thigh is the squad's most stubborn problem, target Atalanta away on Nov 22.
CONFIRMED · Inter.it · Nov 4 — Feyenoord 0-3 Inter: Bisseck 8', Esposito 34', Zielinski 54'. Pavard came on in the 85th, his first minutes since his injury, and Inter kept a second straight clean sheet.
CONFIRMED · Inter.it · Nov 3 — Djed Spence was UEFA's player of the match at De Kuip, his first such award at Inter, with his first Inter assist for Bisseck's opener.
REPORTED · Italpress · Nov 4 — Daniele Chiffi is appointed to referee Inter against Como.
